where: Section 2 and worked example step 6 / Figure
problem: The figure says the 12 impact-selected tests contain only 'GST invoice', but step 6 says those same 12 tests include checkout total, payment amount and refund recalculation as well. The two descriptions of the same set disagree, and a student may think impact selection picked a single feature rather than the tests that exercise the invoice code path.
fix: Make the figure and the example agree: describe the 12 as 'tests touching invoice calculation (GST invoice, checkout total, payment, refund recalculation)'. If the figure must stay tiny, label the innermost ring 'Impact-selected: 12 (invoice path tests)'. Also keep refund recalculation in the ordering only if it is one of the 12; otherwise order just the invoice-path tests and note refund tests come with the 80-test suite.

where: Worked example step 8 and answer, Quiz Q6
problem: 'Runs about 41.7 times fewer tests' is loose English and can be read as 500 minus 41.7×12. The intended meaning is a ratio of test counts.
fix: Write it as a ratio: 'Retest-all runs 500 ÷ 12 ≈ 41.7 times as many tests as impact selection, so impact selection runs about 1/41.7, roughly 2.4%, of the full suite.' In Q6: 'Retest-all runs 400 ÷ 15 ≈ 26.7 times as many tests as impact selection (impact selection is about 3.75% of the full suite); the regression suite runs 60 ÷ 15 = 4 times as many.'
